name: Concurrent prompt inbox; submit while work runs
remaining: Concurrent intake and retry persistence are tested locally; signed-in workers and sustained live load remain separate gates.

name: Durable original prompts and receipts
remaining: Original prompt/client-key records survive grouping, amendments and reopen; target-host recovery and live workload evidence remain.

name: Context-aware project routing
remaining: Explicit links and exact project names route requests; an opt-in semantic router resolves unrouted projects and workflows through a qualified CLI profile and was evaluated only on 25 author-labeled held-out cases. Human-calibrated evaluation, history beyond recent titles and live follow-up journeys remain.

name: Compatible request grouping without lost identities
remaining: One-level grouping preserves child criteria and parent amendments; ambiguous legacy ownership blocks changes. Automatic semantic grouping remains out of scope.

name: Multiple deliverables tracked separately
remaining: Separate deliverables can be reviewed and exported without premature request completion; interpretation and semantic acceptance still require review.

name: New projects and historical reopening
remaining: Reopen preserves criteria and historical lineage; actual customized-user data migration remains target-qualified separately.

name: Explainable/correctable routing and bounded clarification
remaining: Explicit choices and unresolved-project states are inspectable/correctable; richer clarification and semantic routing remain unevaluated.

name: Ordered amendments and retry identity
remaining: Revision checks, idempotent retries and concurrent grouped amendments are covered; live worker response to changes remains separate.

name: Durable project portfolio and priorities
remaining: Project priorities, pauses and filtered views exist; live portfolio load and fairness qualification remain.

name: Scoped cross-project dependencies
remaining: Read grants and host workspace mappings exist; cross-project execution dependencies and hostile-worker isolation require stronger boundaries.

name: Versioned requirements and canonical plans
remaining: Saved criteria/plans survive revisions and preflight rejects stale or malformed scope; semantic completeness of plans remains a review task.

name: Fair scheduling and interactive capacity
remaining: Priority aging/pause and Temporal host interactive reserves are implemented; cross-backend fairness, live contention and large-fleet load remain.

name: Recoverable peer agent identities
remaining: Managed Paperclip identities and Temporal workflow/process receipts preserve ownership; authenticated agent restart/reconciliation needs live qualification.

name: Role/team templates
remaining: Bounded templates and qualified profile selection are wired; live task quality and role suitability are not established by fixtures.

name: Peer versus child ownership and limits
remaining: Parent/dependency validation and child-depth limits exist; distinct native child-versus-peer semantics need coordinator/harness conformance evidence.

name: Durable agent communication with receipts
remaining: Durable messages and ordered receipts are tested; actual peer conversation, backpressure and useful collaboration remain live gates.

name: Independent review and bounded repair
remaining: Independent outcome labels, separate deliverable acceptance and competing-review protection exist; authenticated independence and useful repair loops remain.

name: Harness/model/effort capability profiles
remaining: Exact assistant canary/completion and failed-reprobe invalidation are tested; actual provider/model/effort and both auth modes need target evidence.

name: Captured permitted conversation history
remaining: Actual LCM capture, scoped recall and project-local Codex hook-file merge passed with synthetic messages. Live harness hook activation and complete permitted cross-session capture remain unqualified.

name: Original source archive and anchors
remaining: Original and extracted-text hashes are checked; broader formats, source anchors and corpus-specific extraction fidelity remain.

name: Expandable summaries linked to originals
remaining: Explicit LCM summary/expansion calls validate provider, project and original links; disabled/no-work responses stay not_generated. Provider-generated summary fidelity and repeated real context windows remain unqualified.

name: QMD exact/semantic scoped retrieval
remaining: Actual QMD 2.8.3 CPU embedding/vector retrieval and project isolation passed on a small synthetic corpus. Hybrid reranking and production retrieval quality remain unqualified; the pinned source-build lock mismatch still requires manual review.

name: Whole-corpus coverage accounting
remaining: Inventory/extraction/review accounting is explicit; very large corpus orchestration and proof of complete understanding remain open.

name: Facts, decisions, contradictions and supersession
remaining: Dated assertions, contradictions and supersession remain inspectable; automatic contradiction discovery and truth assessment remain open.

name: Bounded current-context assembly
remaining: Bounded source packets expose omissions; tokenizer-specific limits and evaluated relevance over large contexts remain.

name: Export, invalidation, retention and deletion
remaining: Local invalidation/purge and managed Hindsight/OpenViking deletion/reconciliation are implemented; other external indices, backups and automatic retention remain.

name: One replaceable runtime backend
remaining: Paperclip default and optional Temporal are exclusively selected and fenced; live backend conformance and production cutover remain.

name: Real readiness and capability health
remaining: Doctor, coordinator health, worker pollers, profile probes and observations are distinct; no single check certifies full readiness.

name: Detached parallel execution
remaining: Paperclip issue DAGs and Temporal parallel activities are wired; authenticated detached model runs and production restarts remain.

name: Ralph-style fresh-context continuation
remaining: Both backends implement explicit checkpoint/stop/fresh-generation handoff; five genuine fresh-model sessions and hard context-limit recovery remain unqualified.

name: Bounded iteration and no-progress detection
remaining: Iteration/time and repeated-artifact checks are enforced; semantic no-progress detection and real-model budget behavior remain separate.

name: Crash and uncertain-effect reconciliation
remaining: Durable receipts and uncertain leases block blind replay; OS crash, network partitions and external-effect reconciliation need target/soak evidence.

name: Scoped pause/cancel including shared work
remaining: Grouped withdrawal, new-dispatch pause and scoped cancellation are wired; cancellation status alone does not prove every process stopped.

name: Isolated workspaces and shared resource limits
remaining: Private execution copies, local writer locks, fleet leases and bounded processes exist; distributed workspaces, OS isolation and global resource quotas remain.

name: Native WezTerm navigation
remaining: Native WezTerm has run in the cloud; the user desktop, configuration conflicts, shortcuts, reconnect, sleep and reboot still need qualification.

name: Persistent requests and obligation progress
remaining: Current-revision accepted/total criteria, scoped filters and amendments are tested; target desktop and live workload usability remain.

name: Dedicated Outcomes view
remaining: Persistent outcomes remain separate from logs and selected details survive refresh/log floods; user-desktop outcome-finding evaluation remains.

name: Versioned result cards, checks and limitations
remaining: Versioned cards distinguish planned/fixture/observed state, partial acceptance and evidence checks; semantic result quality remains reviewed.

name: Search, pin, read, reopen and export outcomes
remaining: Search before display limits, pin/read/reopen and immutable multi-deliverable exports are tested; target desktop acceptance remains.

name: Team/agent/child views and meaningful updates
remaining: Team nodes and coordinator observations are shown without claiming plans are live agents; native child semantics and live collaboration usefulness remain.

name: Dependencies, reservations and usage visibility
remaining: Dependency graphs, capacity/reserves and reported CLI token counters are visible; unknown/conflicting usage stays unknown. Live provider costs, subscription balance and CPU/memory telemetry remain.

name: Context health and attention inbox
remaining: Context coverage, health/attention and stale diagnostics are visible; evaluated retrieval health and model context-pressure detection remain.

name: Diagrams, charts and artifact previews
remaining: Plan DAG diagrams and safe HTML/Markdown/JSON exports exist; richer chart generation, artifact preview routing and broad visual inspection remain.

name: Safe, legible, recoverable diagnostics UI
remaining: Escaped diagnostics, malformed-state recovery, narrow layouts and log-flood selection are tested; native target-desktop conformance remains.

name: Superpowers evidence-led brainstorming
remaining: Pinned Superpowers activation and missing-procedure blocking are wired; live brainstorming coverage, useful alternatives and artifact quality remain.

name: Readable plans and executable packets from one model
remaining: Versioned plans feed bounded coordinator packets and human exports; evaluated plan completeness and human/agent understanding remain.

name: Versioned skill activation and resume checks
remaining: Procedure paths/hashes, preflight integrity and resume requirement checks exist; live adherence and companion-file portability remain.

name: Audience and approved writing profile
remaining: Configured audience and word budgets reach plans/outcome lint; approved writing preference retention and meaning-preserving editorial quality remain.

name: Writing Clearly and Concisely, Humanizer and Vale
remaining: Named writing/Humanizer procedures and Vale execution are available; concision without lost meaning, factual quality and reader calibration remain.

name: Rendered, inspected visual documents
remaining: Safe rendered exports and terminal captures exist; broader document formats, diagram/chart quality and human visual acceptance remain.

name: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript and Rust execution packs
remaining: Real Python, JavaScript, TypeScript and Rust process checks and failures are tested; target toolchains/dependencies and end-product behavior remain.

name: Evidence-based evaluation and human calibration
remaining: Per-feature evidence, source binding and calibration mechanisms exist; held-out live judges, semantic quality and human calibration remain.

name: Routing, selection and outcome-finding evaluation
remaining: Lexical routing, plan selection and result-finding cases are tested; held-out semantic routing and model quality/cost comparisons remain.

name: Fault, capacity and soak verification
remaining: Selected concurrency, cancellation, expiry, output/memory bounds and HTTP faults are tested; disk-full, host reboot, physical fleets and 72-hour soak remain.

name: Reviewed improvements with rollback
remaining: Reviewed policy proposals, evidence checks and rollback mechanisms exist; reliable autonomous improvement and held-out regression outcomes remain.

name: One GitHub repository and reproducible packages
remaining: Core/TUI/Temporal packaging and CI are included; all-upstream hash locks and cross-platform reproducibility remain.

name: Harness and linked-project contracts
remaining: CLI/HTTP and typed MCP planning/context/execution tools are wired; actual harness setup and the unavailable linked-project conversation remain uncertified.

name: Doctor, migration, backup, restore and uninstall
remaining: Installation, private workspace/state backup and fixture migration are tested; actual customized-user cutover, recovery and service lifecycle remain.

name: Authorization, credentials and effect audit
remaining: Operator/host-scoped tokens, credential handling and effect receipts are tested; hostile agents still need OS/container isolation and scoped provider credentials.

name: Authorized schedules and clear updates
remaining: Explicit UTC interval schedules coalesce missed ticks; calendar/DST/overlap policies and external destinations remain.

name: Optional OpenViking replacement context backend
remaining: OpenViking managed ingest/recall/read/delete/reconcile is wired; the local archive remains authoritative. Upstream service/model and replacement-backend qualification remain.

name: Optional Hindsight experience memory
remaining: Hindsight managed source copies and derived recall are wired with scope/readback/deletion receipts; actual service/provider and semantic experience-memory quality remain.

name: Optional Temporal execution backend
remaining: Optional real-SDK Temporal workflows, queues, cancellation and explicit rollover are integrated; fixture activities do not qualify real models or production operation.

name: Optional multi-host and larger fleets
remaining: Named hosts, queue/workspace mappings, reserves, scoped remote control and fenced leases are implemented; physical multi-machine models, fault recovery and large-fleet scale remain.

name: Basic Memory editable knowledge and recall
remaining: Actual Basic Memory 1.0.0 create/read/search and competing checksum-guarded edits passed. Arbitrary direct filesystem writers, wider retention and user-machine integration remain outside this qualification.

name: Open Notebook source-workspace integration
remaining: Configured source-workspace/ask adapter exists; actual service generation and a qualified subscription-only inference setup remain.

name: GPT Researcher bounded investigation integration
remaining: Configured bounded research adapter exists; actual sourced investigation, provider setup and a qualified subscription-only inference setup remain.

name: Automatic request-to-team planning
remaining: Explainable lexical workflow templates create bounded DAGs; semantic task decomposition, role selection and company-scale autonomous planning remain unevaluated.

name: Evaluated model and effort selection with explanation
remaining: Explicit override or configured priority selects qualified profiles; this is not benchmark-based best-model/effort selection. Live quality/cost comparison remains.

name: Capability registry and workflow compilation
remaining: Pinned capability activation and validated execution packets are wired; useful automatic skill choice and live procedure adherence still require evaluation.

name: Subscription, API and tested local/hybrid installation profiles
remaining: Official CLI subscription/API/local declarations, probes and optional service auth modes are integrated; real full-profile certification, remote worker auth and external-provider bridges remain.
